policy: Third-party marks are used only as descriptive identifiers for compatible agents and providers. They are not Across Agents Assistant branding.
visual_policy: Official/library glyphs are not redrawn. Reviewed upstream SVGs from LobeHub remain as fallback assets. For Codex, Hermes, and OpenClaw, AAA prefers the LobeHub WebP exports because the reviewed Codex color SVG has a visible path defect. Runtime installed app icons are fallback-only and are not used for Codex or Claude Desktop when bundled open-source icons exist.
runtime_app_icon_visual_treatment: The local-agent icon loader is bundled-first after user overrides and prefers WebP, then PNG, then SVG. Codex uses the LobeHub codex WebP export as its primary bundled icon with SVG fallback, Claude Code uses the LobeHub claudecode-color glyph tile, Claude Desktop uses the generic Claude glyph tile because no reviewed open-source Claude Desktop-specific glyph was found, Hermes uses the hermesagent WebP export as its primary icon with SVG fallback, and OpenClaw uses the openclaw-color WebP export as its primary icon with SVG fallback. Direct WebP local-agent marks are inset at runtime to 78% of their container so they match the legacy neutral-tile visual weight without modifying the source image files. Installed local app icons are fallback-only and are not bundled.
